title: Fix handoff id collision on same-second creation
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: handoff ids are `handoff-<task>-<from>-<idStamp(now)>` (src/core/handoff.ts:47) with second-resolution `idStamp`. Two handoffs for the same task from the same agent within one second collide and the second silently overwrites the first (writes go to `handoffs/<id>.json`). Fix: add a unique suffix (e.g. reuse `mutationStamp`'s random suffix or `postMessage`'s pattern).
acceptance: A test creates two handoffs for the same task/from within the same wall-clock second and asserts both records exist with distinct ids.
Handoff id uniqueness does not rely on wall-clock resolution alone.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes: Reported as audit finding #2 (medium-low). Same root cause as task-claim-id-collision.
